title: VQC-ZTI: Variational Quantum Control for Zero Trust Protection of the Tactile Internet
abstract: arXiv:2608.18572v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Tactile Internet services couple cyber events directly to physical actuation, so security decisions must improve risk discrimination without perturbing the control path. This paper presents VQC-ZTI, a split-plane Variational Quantum Classifier framework for zero-trust protection of Tactile Internet services, in which an off-path VQC analyzes encrypted-flow telemetry while an on-path policy engine applies cached deterministic grant, restrict, step-up, and deny actions. By decoupling anomaly scoring from enforcement, VQC-ZTI preserves predictable control behavior and allows detector sensitivity and policy aggressiveness to be tuned independently. We evaluate the framework on CESNET-derived aggregated traffic using random, entity-group, and temporal holdouts with a hybrid PyTorch-PennyLane implementation. The full-hybrid Quantum Neural Network achieves mean areas under the receiver operating characteristic curve of 0.9981, 0.9974, and 0.9

translated_title: VQC-ZTI：用于触觉互联网零信任保护的变分量子控制
translated_abstract: 触觉互联网服务将网络事件直接与物理执行耦合，因此安全决策必须在不干扰控制路径的前提下提升风险区分能力。本文提出了VQC-ZTI，一个用于触觉互联网服务零信任保护的分平面变分量子分类器框架，其中离路径VQC分析加密流遥测数据，而在路径策略引擎则应用缓存的确定性授予、限制、升级和拒绝操作。通过将异常评分与执行解耦，VQC-ZTI保持了可预测的控制行为，并允许检测器灵敏度和策略攻击性独立调整。我们在基于CESNET衍生的聚合流量上，使用随机、实体组和时间持有组，结合混合PyTorch-PennyLane实现对该框架进行了评估。全混合量子神经网络在接收者操作特征曲线下的平均面积分别达到0.9981、0.9974和0.9。
tldr: VQC-ZTI通过分离量子异常检测与策略执行，实现了触觉互联网零信任保护，在保持控制路径稳定性的同时，显著提升了风险区分精度。
en_tdlr: VQC-ZTI achieves zero-trust protection for the Tactile Internet by decoupling quantum anomaly detection from policy enforcement, enhancing risk discrimination while preserving control-path stability.
